_comment: broca-machina CLAUDE-CLI example — talk to Claude Code in a voice channel. The command transport runs brain.sh, which pipes $VOICE_TRANSCRIPT through `claude -p` and prints the reply. Requires Claude Code installed and on PATH. SECURITY: `claude -p` is a tool-enabled agent — keep discord.allowedUserId set to YOUR user ID so only you can drive it (a stranger's speech would otherwise be an untrusted prompt to an agent with your privileges). Replace every /ABS/PATH/TO/... with real absolute paths and fill in the IDs. See README.md.
